digest.component_or_area: MCP health check and blue-green cutover gate
propositions: /health endpoint returns 200 without exercising the MCP request path or transport-security guards, so containers with misconfigured allowlists are promoted despite returning 421 to real traffic
autodeploy.sh blue-green cutover flips nginx upstream on bare /health 200 without issuing any /mcp request, promoting containers before they have proven they can serve MCP requests

startup handshake should drive one real initialize through StreamableHTTPSessionManager during ASGI lifespan using probe Host from declared resource URL, and report ok/status/elapsed_ms on /health before uvicorn accepts connections
handshake drive must complete inside ASGI lifespan startup, be bounded by timeout with injected clock, never raise or hang, and catch 421 or mismatched allowlist before deployment
autodeploy cutover gate must refuse flip when handshake.ok is present and false, calling record_mcp_backoff_failure not record_backoff_failure, while accepting missing field for mixed-version safety
